learned.claim: doctrine_lint caught real drift on its first run: README claimed 10 subagents while the filesystem had 14 - the corpus gate pays for itself immediately.
The G4/G5 verifier fan-out reproduced a live path traversal: unvalidated intent ids flowed into intent/<id>.intent.json and exfiltrated file content into the hydration bundle.
Append-only logs must be hashed prospectively and written only after ALL validation - append-before-validate corrupted the decisions log on every rejected proposal.
Terminal output must be ASCII-only: Windows cp1252 pipes crash on printed unicode punctuation even when file content is correctly UTF-8.
Fresh-context verifier subagents found 25+ real defects the author missed in his own same-session code - separation of duties works mechanically, not just rhetorically.
